mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT B.MENU_NO AS MENU_NO , B.MENU_ORDR AS MENU_ORDR , B.MENU_NM AS MENU_NM , B.UPPER_MENU_NO AS UPPER_MENU_ID , B.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH AS RELATE_IMAGE_PATH , B.RELATE_IMAGE_NM AS RELATE_IMAGE_NM , B.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS PROGRM_FILE_NM , B.MENU_SE AS MENU_SE , (SELECT C.URL FROM COMTNPROGRMLIST C WHERE B.PROGRM_FILE_NM = C.PROGRM_FILE_NM) AS CHK_URL FROM COMTNMENUCREATDTLS A, COMTNMENUINFO B WHERE A.MENU_NO = B.MENU_NO AND ( #{menuSe,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR B.MENU_SE = #{menuSe,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND A.AUTHOR_CODE = (SELECT AUTHOR_CODE from COMTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS WHERE SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = #{tmpUniqId}) UNION ALL SELECT 990000000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY BM.BBS_NM, BM.BBS_ID) AS MENU_NO , PARENT.BASE_MENU_ORDR + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY BM.BBS_NM, BM.BBS_ID) AS MENU_ORDR , BM.BBS_NM AS MENU_NM , PARENT.MENU_NO AS UPPER_MENU_ID , NULL AS RELATE_IMAGE_PATH , NULL AS RELATE_IMAGE_NM , 'bbsAutoArticle' AS PROGRM_FILE_NM , #{menuSe,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS MENU_SE , '/cop/bbs/selectArticleList.do?bbsId=' || BM.BBS_ID AS CHK_URL FROM COMTNBBSMASTER BM, ( SELECT PARENT_BASE.MENU_NO, NVL((SELECT MAX(CHILD.MENU_ORDR) FROM COMTNMENUINFO CHILD WHERE CHILD.UPPER_MENU_NO = PARENT_BASE.MENU_NO), 0) AS BASE_MENU_ORDR FROM ( SELECT MIN(M.MENU_NO) AS MENU_NO FROM COMTNMENUCREATDTLS A2, COMTNMENUINFO M WHERE A2.MENU_NO = M.MENU_NO AND A2.AUTHOR_CODE = (SELECT AUTHOR_CODE FROM COMTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS WHERE SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = #{tmpUniqId}) AND ( #{menuSe,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR M.MENU_SE = #{menuSe,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND (M.MENU_NM = '게시판관리' OR M.PROGRM_FILE_NM IN ( SELECT PR.PROGRM_FILE_NM FROM COMTNPROGRMLIST PR WHERE LOWER(PR.URL) = LOWER('/cop/bbs/selectBBSMasterInfs.do') )) ) PARENT_BASE ) PARENT WHERE BM.USE_AT = 'Y' AND NVL(BM.BLOG_AT, 'N') != 'Y' AND PARENT.MENU_NO IS NOT NULL AND ( #{menuSe,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{menuSe,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IN ('USER', 'ADMIN') ) ) X ORDER BY MENU_ORDR
